3.name: Wode
steps: You? You're always welcome here. Yes, yes.
The castle needs a key. The key needs an offering.
The key to the castle is on an altar. But it won't let it go easily.
We have a skull tablet. Necromancers use them to appease bound spirits.

4.name: Eyeleen
steps: They're in the locked castle? You need to get in!
The altar south of the castle has a spirit bound to it.
A skull tablet is a great offering to bound spirits.
I would never keep you out of our home.

5.name: Freetoleave Ghost
steps: You want the skull thing, right? It's furthest in.
No need to pay attention to me!
Would you look at the time? You should probably get the tablet to the altar.
